recent.title: QPaint Quote Intake — False Completion
recent.summary: 3 quotes marked complete with $0 deal values. Root cause: no certification gate between extraction and label. Fixed: certify_intake_complete() + Intake Exception state.

recent.title: ATTEMPTED ≠ COMPLETED
recent.summary: Automation success ≠ business outcome success. Every critical workflow must verify the business state, not just the process completion.

recent.title: HTTP 200 ≠ Application Success
recent.summary: HQ certification requires visual rendering verification, not just HTTP status. Deploy → verify dependencies → verify render → certify.

call_framework.opening: G'day [name], James here. I emailed you recently but thought I'd give you a quick call. I've been speaking with painting businesses about what happens after they send a quote. What do you normally do once you've sent one?
call_framework.if_no: G'day, James here. Is the owner around? I wanted a quick word about how you follow up your quotes.
discovery: What actually happens after you send a quote?
Who follows them up, and how many times?
Do you know your quote-to-job conversion rate?
Do quotes just sit in the system and go quiet?

objection_handling.already_have_a_system: That's great — let's see if we can make it work harder for you.
objection_handling.too_busy: That's exactly the point — this runs itself.
objection_handling.not_interested: No worries at all — thanks for your time.

founder_call_day.voicemail: G'day [name], James Hardstaff here from Not Forgotten. I'll send you a quick email so it's not a cold call next time. Cheers.
